instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: A micro-biotech focused generic drug manufacturer producing oral solid dosage forms across eight therapeutic categories. With EU GMP certification, the company maintains strict quality standards for high-volume production. Currently investing in continuous manufacturing line technology to replace traditional batch processing, aiming to increase throughput and reduce operational waste.
answers.pastInitiatives: The firm operates strictly on an ad-hoc basis; innovation is primarily reactive problem-solving driven by immediate supply chain or quality control issues. There is no dedicated budget for R&D, no structured ideation pipeline, and historical data shows zero successful experiments with novel technologies.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is aggressive revenue growth toward €50M ARR within five years by expanding our addressable market segments. This includes pivoting pricing strategies from single-dose payments to recurring subscription models and developing a robust enterprise sales motion.
answers.additionalContext: The company benefits from low immediate regulatory friction in the generic space but struggles with scaling operational expertise and formalized strategic planning.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Operational Efficiency via Continuous Manufacturing Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Transitioning to continuous manufacturing offers immediate incremental gains in throughput and waste reduction, directly impacting the bottom line without requiring massive R&D expenditure. This leverages current investment direction.

first_actions: Conduct detailed process mapping audit of existing batch lines.
Pilot a small-scale continuous processing simulation on one high-volume product.
resources_needed: Consultant for process flow optimization (budget allocation: 2%)
Internal time reallocation from founder operations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase overall tablet throughput by 15% within six months.
milestones: Q1: Complete waste reduction audit and set baseline metrics.
Q3: Implement pilot optimization results into standard operating procedure (SOP).

opportunities.title: Low-Cost Digital Patient Engagement Platform (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Given the micro size and low budget, developing a highly localized, AI-driven digital patient support or chronic condition monitoring tool could create an entirely new revenue stream. This is high risk but offers potential exponential scalability if validated.

first_actions: Identify one specific patient pain point within the 8 therapeutic categories.
Develop a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) using off-the-shelf cloud services.
resources_needed: Freelance developer contract for MVP build (budget allocation: 3%)
Minimal marketing spend for beta testing (budget allocation: 1%)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 100 active user sign-ups and retention rate of >40% in the pilot cohort.
milestones: Q2: MVP development and internal usability testing.
Q4: Launch controlled beta for a specific geographic market.

next_steps.action: Identify and engage external technical advisor for R&D strategy.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation pipeline (Process is 'none')
Critical talent gap in specialized technical evaluation expertise
Zero digital maturity hindering scalable growth and data utilization
Reliance on owner-dependent decision-making, creating single point of failure risk
